title: Shopify development

seo.title: Shopify development agency
seo.description: Custom Shopify storefronts, product configurators and replatforming for brands that have outgrown a stock theme. Fixed-price builds from $12,000.

answerBlock: Shopify development is building a store on Shopify with a custom theme, the right apps and product data set up around how you sell. Calwebtech builds custom Shopify storefronts, product configurators and migrations from other platforms, keeping pages quick and orders flowing into your other systems. Most Shopify projects cost $12,000 to $60,000, depending on customisation, migration and integrations.

hero.outcome: A Shopify store that looks like your brand rather than a theme demo, sells made-to-order products properly and stays quick on a phone.

problem.heading: When does a Shopify store need custom development?
problem.intro: Brands usually bring us a Shopify project at one of three moments.

situations.title: Stuck on a page builder or an old platform
situations.body: The current store is hard to change, slow on mobile and expensive to extend, and moving to Shopify feels risky for search and for customers.

situations.title: Products do not fit a standard product page
situations.body: Made-to-order pieces, bundles or options with rules need a configurator, and apps only get part of the way there.

situations.title: The theme is fighting the brand
situations.body: Every campaign needs a workaround, the store looks like thousands of others, and app scripts have piled up on every page.

included.heading: What is included in a Shopify build?
items: A custom theme built from editable sections, so your team changes pages without code
Product configurators for made-to-order items, with options, rules and live pricing
Collections, search and filtering set up around your catalogue
Checkout, shipping, tax and payment settings configured and tested
An audited app list, with custom code where an app would slow every page
Migration of products, customers and order history from your current platform
A permanent redirect for every old product, collection and page URL
Integrations with your inventory, ERP, fulfilment or marketing tools
A written performance budget for product and collection pages on mobile
Training on products, collections, promotions and the theme editor

process.heading: How does a Shopify project run?
process.intro: Six to eight weeks for most custom storefronts, and nine to fourteen with configurators, large migrations and integrations.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.body: Catalogue, product options, apps, integrations and the migration plan, agreed with a fixed scope.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: Home, collection, product, configurator and cart screens designed for your brand, starting from the phone.

steps.title: Build
steps.body: Theme, sections, configurator and integrations on a development store, with products and customers migrated in test runs.

steps.title: Prove
steps.body: Order, payment and tax testing, redirect checks, accessibility and a performance pass against the budget.

steps.title: Launch
steps.body: Final migration, domain cutover, monitoring and team training, with Search Console watched for the first thirty days.

pricing.heading: How much does a Shopify store cost?
pricing.intro: Most custom Shopify storefronts land between $12,000 and $25,000. Configurators, large migrations and integrations move a project into the $25,000 to $60,000 band.

factors.title: Theme customisation
factors.body: Adapting a strong theme costs less than a fully custom theme with its own section library.

factors.title: Configurators
factors.body: Made-to-order options with rules and live pricing need their own interface, logic and testing.

factors.title: Migration
factors.body: Products, customers and orders from another platform need cleaning, matching and redirects.

factors.title: Integrations
factors.body: Inventory, ERP and fulfilment connections add build and testing time.

faq.heading: What do buyers ask about Shopify development?

items.question: Are you a Shopify Partner?
items.answer: Yes, since 2019. We still recommend WooCommerce or a custom storefront when either would suit your catalogue and team better.

items.question: Can you move our store to Shopify without losing search traffic?
items.answer: Yes. We migrate products, customers and order history, map every old URL to its new address with permanent redirects before launch, and monitor Search Console for the first thirty days.

items.question: Can Shopify handle made-to-order or configurable products?
items.answer: Yes, with a configurator built for your options and rules. We replatformed a furniture brand from a page builder to Shopify with a configurator for its made-to-order pieces.

items.question: How long does a Shopify build take?
items.answer: Six to eight weeks for most custom storefronts, and nine to fourteen with configurators, large migrations or integrations.

items.question: Will we be able to edit the store ourselves?
items.answer: Yes. Pages are built from editable sections in the theme editor, and your team gets training on products, collections and promotions at handover.

items.question: Do we need Shopify Plus?
items.answer: Most brands do not. Plus becomes worth considering for high order volumes, wholesale features or checkout changes beyond the standard plans. We tell you which plan fits before you commit, with the running costs written down.

items.question: Who owns the store and its data?
items.answer: You do. The store, the theme code and every app account are registered in your name, and the theme repository is handed over with its documentation.
